canon.title: Europe, 1785–1828
canon.about: Classical facts of an age where music, letters, philosophy, science, art and the relations of states meet: from Mozart's quartets for Haydn to Schubert's death, through the wars of Napoleon and the Congress of Vienna. A seed canon, to test the method: drafted from general knowledge by a language model, each assertion naming the standard reference it is to be checked against; none is checked yet.

ties.note: Ries reports that Beethoven took Haydn's advice against the third trio for envy.
Goethe to Zelter, 2 September 1812: an utterly untamed personality.
At Erfurt Talleyrand counsels the tsar against Napoleon, in secret; the sign is the historian's (codebook §6).
In October 1814 Metternich would grant Prussia Saxony for help against Russia over Poland; by December he had broken with Prussia.
